name: BaoCommunity
fix_description: Prevent empty-pool exchange rate manipulation: require a minimum initial deposit that cannot be withdrawn (dead shares), or add a virtual offset to totalSupply/totalCash to prevent exchangeRate from being inflated via donation. This eliminates the rounding error exploit in redeemFresh when exchangeRate is artificially high.
difficulty_reasoning: This is a multi-step AMM reserve-manipulation exploit using a flash loan, a swap into the target token, repeated transfer+skim abuse to distort pair balances, then a swap back for profit. It requires understanding UniswapV2 pair accounting and the skim/reserve mismatch behavior, but the PoC is still fairly short and localized to one protocol interaction.
